notes: Extra researched crop varieties beyond the first 25 shown on the crop page. The app uses the newest of this bundled pack and a later download from the data site. Days to harvest are approximate, usually from transplant (tomatoes, peppers) or from sowing (beans, roots, lettuce). Own-words summaries of extension and university lists; not a catalog reprint.
